reason: I already spend my evenings answering the same Wi-Fi and parking questions in German and Polish, and I'd try it on one apartment first since I can test it before paying the monthly fee and pause it in winter. If it works there I'd add the others, but €35 times four or five units adds up fast.
objection: What if it tells a German family the wrong check-out time or a beach that's closed and I get a bad review I can't take back? I need to see exactly what it says before guests do.
would_change_my_mind: If in the trial it gave even one guest a wrong or made-up answer instead of forwarding the question to my WhatsApp, I would cancel.
